proposed_comments.body:
### Distinguish the internal clipboard sentinel from the wire value

**Severity:** `low`

Non-blocking documentation clarification: this C# property uses an empty string when clipboard access is unavailable, whereas `EndpointWorker.ps1` projects that unavailable value as JSON null and also emits `ClipboardAvailable`. Please make that boundary explicit here so readers do not assume the internal empty-string sentinel is the wire contract. The existing comment is correct for this class; this only clarifies its relationship to the serialized result and does not change clipboard behavior.

```suggestion
        // Unavailable uses an empty digest internally; EndpointWorker serializes it as null.
        // Check Available rather than inferring availability from the digest.
```

confidence.rationale: Exact current source supports this explicitly non-blocking clarification; existing guards and caller behavior are preserved.

proposed_comments.title: Distinguish the internal clipboard sentinel from the wire value
